title: Shipping a RAG System That Holds Up in Production
excerpt: Retrieval demos are easy and retrieval products are not. Chunking, reranking, evaluation, and the failure modes that only show up once real users start asking real questions.

title: How Far Can You Get With a Small Model?
excerpt: Before reaching for the largest model available, it is worth measuring what a well-tuned small one already does. A look at where the quality curve actually bends.

title: Designing Interfaces for Uncertain Systems
excerpt: Models are probabilistic and interfaces usually pretend otherwise. Patterns for showing confidence, surfacing sources, and letting people correct the machine.
